proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature.catalog_ref.languages_override
proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summons can encode initiative, command, and dismissal behavior, but cannot encode that the summoned creature understands the summoner's languages without duplicating the whole stat block inline.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental ... understands your languages, obeys your commands..."

proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature.item_rooted_nearest_space_placement
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface only has a coarse range header for spawned creatures. This item needs deterministic placement in the nearest unoccupied space to the censer, not merely a generic self-ranged summon.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible..."

notes: Authored as a magic_item spawned_creature and traced successfully. Range=self is only a coarse proxy for item-rooted nearest-space placement, and the catalog-ref payload omits the language-understanding rider.
